compiled_state.description:
Discovered from ADEVX-102.

A ticket that declares a resolvable base branch now causes two git ls-remote calls for the same repo and branch in one start. The first runs in _start through IntakeContext.base_resolver.resolve_base, which uses only the truthiness of the result and discards the SHA. The second runs inside TemporalStarter.start through remote_head.

Carrying the resolved SHA from the pre-check into IntakeStart would remove the second lookup. The reviewer rated the performance impact at zero, so this is tidiness rather than a hot path.

Files: services/orchestration/intake_reconciler.py, services/orchestration/intake_runtime.py.
compiled_state.title: Reuse the resolved base SHA instead of running git ls-remote twice
